name: model-card-flat-used-in
goal: Model cards show only their name and flat Used In links while helper cards retain consumer categories.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Model cards should show their name and Used In links without category labels; helper cards retain grouped labels. The feature spec records the same behavior at tip and commit on desktop, tablet and mobile.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing three-viewport reviewModelCard scenario checked model names and links but accepted category-group lists, so the extra headings were never rejected. Extend it to require one unnamed flat model list and no Components or Services heading while the same matrix continues requiring those groups for helper cards.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red checkpoint fb7da79bd7be2eaa64b11bef289c1a6a54520694, proof 82c5285c687b50d14c7e19bf72b93e34c9e85e9699f5d76f1bca1cb80d89e6a0: the unchanged catalog matrix fails at desktop, tablet and mobile because the model footer has 3 lists where the regression requires 1.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: ExplorerUsage now supports a grouped default and a flat layout selected only for model rows; component contracts describe the variant.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
